messages:
alex_support: Escalating to CS 2 Veridian Health trial ingestion failing on tokenization. Customer stuck on activation, tagging for priority handoff.

maya_cs: Thanks. Can you paste the error snippet and confirm if this is likely our runtime or their payload? We need to notify the customer ASAP with an ETA. @jordan_pm heads up on trial impact.

alex_support: Short log: 
```
2026-03-05T09:14:21Z ERROR ingest: TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence at offset 1532
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/ingest/worker.py", line 198, in run_batch
    out = tokenizer.encode_batch(items)
TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence
```
Support thinking this is malformed upstream data. Estimated time to confirm: ~2 hours.

maya_cs: Comms suggestion: 1) immediate ack to customer with 2h investigation ETA, 2) offer a 30m triage call and a quick sanitize script, 3) offer manual CSV ingest fallback to keep trial active. Agree?

jordan_pm: Agree. Also propose a short pre-ingest checklist and a tiny validation script we can send so PMs can self-check before trial. I'll draft it.

liam_se: Tech note: common causes are null bytes or wrong charset. If theyre exporting from a Java pipeline, double-encoding can sneak in. Ill attach a sanitize script and a minimal repro that removes bad bytes and normalizes to NFC. If they cant run it, we can accept a CSV and run it here.

maya_cs: Owners: alex_support (ticket updates + triage), liam_se (sanitize script + repro), jordan_pm (checklist + enablement one-pager), maya_cs (customer comms + fallback coordination). Timeline: initial ack within 30m, status update in 2h, remediation options within 6h.

alex_support: Sending ack now: "Thanks 2 were investigating a tokenizer error; ETA for next update ~2 hours. We can run a quick sanitize or accept a CSV fallback to keep your trial progressing."

escalation_bot: Auto-runbook created: https://console.redwood/escalations/1766000000 (priority: trial-impact).

jordan_pm: Draft validation snippet: 
```
# quick-validate.sh
python - <<'PY'
import sys,unicodedata
for fname in sys.argv[1:]:
    b=open(fname,'rb').read()
    b=b.replace(b'\x00',b'')
    try:
        t=b.decode('utf-8')
    except Exception:
        print('INVALID:',fname)
        raise
    print('OK:',fname)
PY
```

liam_se: On triage call we found a null byte in a sample file. Ran sanitize locally and sample ingested successfully. Pushed script to the ticket and added reproduction steps.

maya_cs: Customer elected the live call and we unblocked the trial during the session. Follow-ups: jordan_pm to add the validation checklist to onboarding emails, liam_se to PR sanitize script into repo, alex_support to close ticket and note the workaround. Closing escalation: trial resumed. :thumbsup:
